messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Helio wants a compact enablement surge next Tue/Wed for three product teams. They asked for hands-on office hours + a 90m migration workshop. Need to confirm facilitators and pre-reads. :wave:

jenna_support: I can cover the migration workshop (infra + auth). What time windows are they suggesting? PST preferred but they have EMEA folks.

maria_cs: They said morning PST (10am) works for the core team, but SEs in EMEA will join later. Thinking: run 10:00–11:30 PT and repeat a slightly trimmed 16:00–17:30 PT for EMEA overlap. Thoughts?

tony_eng: 10:00 PT is fine for me. For the repeat session can we make it 60m focused deep-dive (handbook + live demo) rather than full workshop? Keeps ops load lower.

sasha_success: Agree w/ Tony. Suggest: Tue = hands-on migration workshop (90m, pre-req: test account + samples), Wed = office hours (60m per team block). We should capture feedback via short NPS + a 3-question form after each session.

maria_cs: Perfect. Can someone draft the pre-read checklist and invite details? I can handle invites once times are locked. Also want to surface renewal risk flags to CSM lead if any blockers come up during workshop.

jenna_support: I'll draft the pre-read: environment checklist, sample prompts, recommended model + quantization profile, access steps. Posting draft in a sec.

calendar-bot: Poll created: https://cal.redwood/poll/helio-172 — options: Tue 10:00 PT / Tue 16:00 PT / Wed 10:00 PT / Wed 16:00 PT. Vote by EOD Friday.

maria_cs: Tagging @tony_eng @jenna_support @sasha_success — please vote and add any hard constraints.

tony_eng: voted. constraint: need GPU pool reserved for live demo (dedicated). If calendar says 10:00 PT we're good.

jenna_support: drafted pre-read here: https://docs.redwood/internal/helio-pre-read — will paste bullet version below for invite.

jenna_support: ```Pre-read (5–10 min):
- Create Helio test org + API key
- Upload sample dataset (CSV) and confirm schema
- Confirm network egress rules for private deploys (if relevant)
- Bring one migration use-case prompt per attendee
```

sasha_success: For feedback capture: I'll spin up a quick Typeform with NPS + 2 open prompts (what worked, what's blocked). We'll surface any renewal risks flagged >3/10 NPS to the AM immediately.

maria_cs: Nice. One more ops ask: can eng pair with CS for the first 30m of the workshop for the live demo to reduce context switching? Tony?

tony_eng: Yep I can do the first 30m and then stay in the office-hours follow-up channel. Also will prepare a 5-slide runbook for debugging the common auth + latency issues.

maria_cs: Assigning action owners: jenna = pre-read + invite copy, sasha = feedback form + post-session triage, tony = demo + runbook. I'll send invites once poll closes.

sasha_success: Quick note — Helio asked for post-session lab access (48h sandbox). Who can grant?

jenna_support: We can provision a temp dedicated pool for 72h (ops OK). Need billing sign-off; I'll cc finance in the invite.

maria_cs: Good — add a line in the invite about 72h sandbox and billing contact.

Calendar-bot: Reminder set: poll closes in 18 hours.

maria_cs: Last item — agenda stub for invite (will paste into calendar once times chosen):
```
10:00–10:10 Intro + goals (CS)
10:10–10:40 Live migration demo (Eng)
10:40–11:10 Hands-on lab (facilitators help attendees)
11:10–11:25 Q&A + escalation capture (CS/Eng)
11:25–11:30 Feedback/NPS link (CS)
```

tony_eng: Looks good. I'll attach the runbook PDF to the invite.

sasha_success: I'll set the feedback form and the post-session triage board (tickets tagged helio-enable).

maria_cs: Thanks team. If poll lands on the repeat window, we'll shorten the second session to the demo + Q&A + NPS. Will follow up with the invite link and pre-reads. :thumbsup:

jenna_support: Cool — ping if you want me to drop the pre-read into the Helio workspace message.

maria_cs: Done for now — will update thread after poll closes. Appreciate the quick turns on this. :rocket:
